description: Source file defining the DocumentsFragment class, which manages UI for listing, searching, exporting, and merging documents in an Android app.

classes.name: DocumentsFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that displays a list of documents, provides search functionality, and allows exporting or merging selected documents.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of DocumentsFragment.

methods.name: onAttach
methods.description: Initializes the DocumentRepository when the fragment is attached to a context.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout and initializes RecyclerView and SearchView references.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up RecyclerView, search listener, and menu provider after view creation.

methods.name: addMenu
methods.description: Adds menu options for exporting and merging documents.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads documents from the repository, optionally filtered by a search query.

methods.name: exportSelected
methods.description: Exports selected documents to a PDF file.

methods.name: mergeSelected
methods.description: Merges selected documents into a single PDF.

methods.name: onDestroyView
methods.description: Cleans up references to views when the fragment view is destroyed.
